international.title: UK disability benefit cuts risk worsening youth destitution, research warns
international.summary: Joseph Rowntree Foundation report says millions could be left unable to regularly afford everyday basics Cuts to disability benefits are likely to increase the risks of destitution faced by young people and leave millions of people unable to regularly afford everyday basics such as food, shelter and clothing, according to new research. Destitution is “becoming the norm” with about 3.8 million people, including 1 million children, experiencing the most extreme form of financial hardship in the UK last year, says the Joseph Rowntree Foundation.
